maria_cs: Quick check — AuroraPay weekly health: token usage basically flat WoW, but p95 latency doubled and 5xx rate spiked to ~0.6%. CC @dave_eng @kai_sre any visibility?

 dave_eng: Looking now. I pushed a batching tweak last Wed aimed at reducing tail latency during bursts, but logs show a weird pattern for short responses. Pulling recent traces.

 ops-bot: Alert — RATE_ALERT aurorapay /generate 5xx > 0.5% (last 15m) — autoscale triggered :bell:

 kai_sre: Summary from infra: KV cache miss rate jumped ~18x at 03:12 UTC, correlated with a flood of small requests. /generate returned ~120 500s in a 10m window. Raw numbers: tokens WoW +3%, QoQ +12%. p95 latency WoW 220ms -> 460ms. error rate WoW 0.12% -> 0.6%.

 dave_eng: Hypothesis: batching window shortened accidentally (too aggressive to reduce latency for large responses), creating many tiny batches -> higher CPU overhead and model tail. Recommend quick rollback to previous batching params and pin to stable model v1.3. Command I'll run for rollback: ```redwoodctl rollback --customer aurorapay --deployment=prod --to=2026-03-10T22:00Z``` Also tuning flags I plan: `--max-batch=32 --batch-window-ms=15 --enable-prefix-cache`.

 maria_cs: Customer has renewal discussion next Tue and flagged this in prep. They asked for concrete predictability/mitigation steps.

 jess_enablement: I'll join renewal and prepare a one-slide explainers on throughput knobs + caching. Dave, can you share expected p95 delta post-rollback?

 dave_eng: Expect p95 down ~30% from current within ~30 minutes of canary. Error rate should fall below 0.2%. I'll schedule canary at 16:00 PST and post metrics.

 maria_cs: Action list: dave -> rollback + canary (ETA 16:00 PST); kai -> monitor 5m & 1h windows and set alert threshold to 0.3%; jess -> renewal slide + enablement doc; I'll update account risk to "medium" and ping AM. Quick QoQ/WoW bullet numbers for notes: QoQ tokens 12,000,000 -> 13,440,000 (+12%); WoW tokens 325,000 -> 335,750 (+3.3%); avg spend WoW +8% (retries & higher p95 drove additional cost).

 kai_sre: I'll add an ad-hoc dashboard with `errors/5m`, `p95_latency/5m`, `tokens/min` and drop a short runbook snippet: ```if 5xx > 0.3% then rollback last batching change; if latency stays > 300ms escalate to infra-eng```

 maria_cs: Thanks — I'll update the account tracker and share a brief note to the customer post-canary. Ping here when canary finishes.

 ops-bot: Deploy canary started by dave_eng at 1955560200 :rocket:

 dave_eng: Canary complete — p95 460ms -> 320ms, 5xx -> 0.18%. Rolling to 50% now, will promote to 100% in ~20m if steady.

 maria_cs: Great. Marking as monitoring. Will re-evaluate risk after the full roll.
